pairs.original: Human beings should remain the end that AI serves, and should not be treated as a stage to surpass.
pairs.rewrite: AI should serve human beings as its end, and humanity should not be treated as a stage to be surpassed.

pairs.original: The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and be received.
pairs.rewrite: The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and how people will receive it.

pairs.original: Popular self-government should remain the basis of political authority, rather than rule by experts, executives or other unelected powers.
pairs.rewrite: Political authority should rest on popular self-government rather than on experts, executives or other unelected powers.

pairs.original: Public promises about advanced AI are mostly inflated hype.
pairs.rewrite: Most public promises about what advanced AI will achieve are greatly exaggerated.

new_statements.text: Public fear of AI exceeds what the evidence supports.
Serious work on controlling advanced AI should happen well before such systems exist.
